{{Quote|A-racks, stop; gunners, grab the E-Webs. Kicker, find me some useful real estate.|[[Line Lieutenant]] [[Dramos Sanjin]]|<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref>}}
'''Kicker''' was a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] who served the [[Empire of the Hand]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Kicker participated in a [[Attack on the Red City|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]], fighting against the [[Quesoth Soldier|forces]] of the [[Quesoth]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
